result.summary: Integration tests for test-integration-startup_assertions: 2 pass, 3 fail. The ISS-0660 fix approach is broken in the standard test environment. Issue 1 (BLOCKER): assertDatabaseConfiguration_success and assertDatabaseConfiguration_with_overrides_success both fail with error.PublicSchemaPollutionPreCheck because bpm_test always has 38 application tables in public schema; returning a non-SkipZigTest error from a Zig test permanently fails the test. Issue 2 (BLOCKER): assertDatabaseConfiguration_public_schema_polluted fails because pg_trgm is not installed in bpm_test — no migration installs it — so the production function returns PgExtensionMissing before reaching the PublicSchemaPollution check. Build check (zig build) and infrastructure pre-check (test-env-verify) both PASS.

issues.description: assertDatabaseConfiguration_success FAIL: hard pre-check returns error.PublicSchemaPollutionPreCheck because bpm_test has 38 application tables in public schema. Zig test runner treats any non-SkipZigTest error return as a test failure. The ISS-0660 fix made both success tests permanently fail on the standard integration database.

assertDatabaseConfiguration_with_overrides_success FAIL: same pre-check issue as above. The with_overrides variant only bypasses version/extension checks; the public-schema check still queries the real DB.

assertDatabaseConfiguration_public_schema_polluted FAIL: expected error.PublicSchemaPollution, found error.PgExtensionMissing. pg_trgm is not installed in bpm_test (confirmed: no migration runs CREATE EXTENSION pg_trgm). The production function checks pg_trgm before the pollution check, so PgExtensionMissing fires first. Fix requires: (1) add migration to CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm, (2) extend assertDatabaseConfigurationWithOverrides with a public_table_count_override parameter so success tests work on bpm_test.

result.next_action: Route back to BACKEND-DEV for rework — fix approach requires: (1) add pg_trgm migration, (2) extend assertDatabaseConfigurationWithOverrides with table count override so success tests do not rely on a clean public schema
